original.target_description: Experiment 2 relationship between stimulus velocity and reaction time to colour change at a fixed central location, across three colour-change probabilities. Relationship located in narrative and Fig. 3; no main-effect F or corresponding p printed.

n.sample_role: Female observers contributing reaction times in Experiment 2; two had also taken part in Experiment 1.
n.exclusions: Results report 10 missing responses, 17 anticipations and 74 false alarms; no participant exclusion reported. Final trial count and exact exclusion rule not separately supplied for this experiment.
